items.name: mintel-theme
items.title: Mintel Theme
items.description: M-Intelligence brand theme: colors (light + dark), fonts and radius. Install this first.

theme.font-sans: var(--font-manrope, Manrope), var(--font-plex-thai, "IBM Plex Sans Thai"), ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif
theme.font-heading: var(--font-rubik, Rubik), var(--font-plex-thai, "IBM Plex Sans Thai"), ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif
theme.font-mono: var(--font-jetbrains, "JetBrains Mono"), ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace

items.name: theme-clarity
items.title: Mintel Clarity Theme
items.description: Calm and content-first: system font, larger reading sizes, layered dark mode, continuous corners. Install after mintel-theme.

theme.font-sans: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, var(--font-plex-thai, "IBM Plex Sans Thai"), sans-serif
theme.font-heading: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, var(--font-plex-thai, "IBM Plex Sans Thai"), sans-serif

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Button with Mintel brand variants (default, brand gradient, secondary, outline, ghost, destructive, link).

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: Status badge with brand, soft, success, warning and destructive variants.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: Card container with header, title, description, action, content and footer slots.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: Text input styled with Mintel tokens.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: Modal dialog with blurred overlay and zoom-in animation.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: Accessible select dropdown with brand check indicator.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: Data table with header, body, footer, caption and row hover.

items.name: stepper
items.title: Stepper
items.description: Stage progress: a Salesforce-style chevron path or numbered wizard steps, with completed checks, a highlighted current step and optional clicks.

items.name: timeline
items.title: Timeline
items.description: Vertical event history with colored dots or icons, times, descriptions and a pulsing current step.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: Round avatar with image, initials fallback, presence dot, brand-gradient ring and an overlapping group.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: Loading placeholder with a soft light sweep; pulses gently under reduced motion.

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: Linear progress that eases to its value, with brand/success/warning/destructive tones and an indeterminate sweep.

items.name: progress-ring
items.title: Progress ring
items.description: Percentage ring that sweeps to its value, in the brand gradient or status colors.

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: Inline message in default, brand, success, warning and destructive tones, with an optional icon.

items.name: empty-state
items.title: Empty state
items.description: “Nothing here yet” block: icon in a soft brand halo, title, description and actions.

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: Expandable sections with a smooth height animation and a chevron that springs open.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: Path to the current page with chevron separators and an ellipsis for long trails.

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Page navigation with first/last pages, ellipses, a brand pill on the current page, and Thai labels.

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.description: Panel that slides in from any edge with a spring; bottom sheets get a grab handle and safe-area padding.

items.name: command
items.title: Command palette
items.description: ⌘K command palette in a dialog: groups, icons, shortcuts, Thai search, animated list height.

items.name: sidebar
items.title: Sidebar
items.description: App shell: a sidebar that collapses to an icon rail (⌘B) and becomes an off-canvas panel on phones, with groups, badges and an active marker.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: Single or range slider with a brand-gradient track and a thumb that grows and shows its value while dragged.

items.name: toggle-group
items.title: Toggle group
items.description: Buttons that stay pressed, one or many at a time, with a brand tint and a small spring.

items.name: tag-input
items.title: Tag input
items.description: Free-form tags: Enter/comma adds, Backspace removes, paste splits, duplicates ignored, optional suggestions.

items.name: file-upload
items.title: File upload
items.description: Drag-and-drop file picker with type and size checks, a file list and per-file progress.

items.name: thai-address
items.title: Thai address
items.description: Province → district → sub-district with the postal code filled in, or type the postal code first. Bangkok uses khet/khwaeng. Ships the dataset to public/mintel/thai-address.json and loads it lazily.

items.name: thai-id-input
items.title: Thai ID input
items.description: Thai national ID field that formats as 1-2345-67890-12-3 and checks the check digit.

items.name: thai-phone-input
items.title: Thai phone input
items.description: Thai phone field: 081-234-5678 / 02-123-4567 formatting, accepts pasted +66 numbers, gives you the E.164 form.

items.name: otp-input
items.title: OTP input
items.description: One-time code boxes with auto-advance, paste and SMS autofill, a pop on each digit and a shake when wrong.

items.name: data-table
items.title: Data table
items.description: TanStack Table with search, sortable headers, row selection and pagination, in Mintel styling.

items.name: chart
items.title: Chart
items.description: recharts wrapper that maps series to the Mintel data palette, with a glassy tooltip and legend.

items.name: grouped-list
items.title: Grouped list
items.description: Settings-style rounded sections of rows with icons, values, chevrons and trailing controls; separators start after the icon.

items.name: conversation
items.title: Conversation
items.description: Chat thread for LINE / Messenger / TikTok / WhatsApp: day dividers, grouped bubbles, read receipts, attachments, typing indicator, composer and a new-messages pill.

items.name: collapsing-header
items.title: Collapsing header
items.description: Big page title that hands off to a compact title in a translucent sticky bar as you scroll.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Tabs with brand-colored active tab and fade-in content.

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: Toast notifications (sonner) themed with brand tokens; follows the dark class on <html>. Render <Toaster /> once, then call toast().

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.description: Accessible form label.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: Auto-growing textarea (field-sizing), 16px on phones to avoid iOS zoom.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: Checkbox with indeterminate state, spring press and 44px touch target.

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Radio Group
items.description: Radio group with spring press and 44px touch targets.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: Toggle switch with spring-eased thumb (default / sm).

items.name: form
items.title: Form
items.description: react-hook-form + zod building blocks with accessible labels, descriptions and errors.

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: Searchable select (single / multiple chips / async) on Radix Popover + cmdk; Thai search.

items.name: calendar
items.title: Calendar
items.description: Thai calendar with Buddhist Era (BE) years by default; single, multiple and range modes.

items.name: date-picker
items.title: Date Picker
items.description: Date and date-range pickers showing Buddhist Era (BE) years by default; values stay JS Dates.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown Menu
items.description: Menu with items, checkbox/radio items, submenus, shortcuts and destructive variant.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: Tooltip that works without a provider; dark-on-light, animated.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: Floating panel anchored to a trigger.

items.name: font-size-control
items.title: Font Size Control
items.description: Text-size control (ก- ก ก+ / A- A A+) that scales the root font size and remembers the choice; includes a no-flash head script.

items.name: animated-beam
items.title: Animated Beam
items.description: An animated beam of light which travels along a path. Useful for showcasing the integration features of a website.

items.name: animated-gradient-text
items.title: Animated Gradient Text
items.description: An animated gradient background which transitions between colors for text.

items.name: aurora-text
items.title: Aurora Text
items.description: A beautiful aurora text effect

items.name: blur-fade
items.title: Blur Fade
items.description: Blur fade in and out animation. Used to smoothly fade in and out content.

items.name: border-beam
items.title: Border Beam
items.description: An animated beam of light which travels along the border of its container.

items.name: dot-pattern
items.title: Dot Pattern
items.description: A background dot pattern made with SVGs, fully customizable using Tailwind CSS.

items.name: magic-card
items.title: Magic Card
items.description: A spotlight effect that follows your mouse cursor and highlights borders on hover.

items.name: marquee
items.title: Marquee
items.description: An infinite scrolling component that can be used to display text, images, or videos.

items.name: meteors
items.title: Meteors
items.description: A meteor shower effect.

items.name: number-ticker
items.title: Number Ticker
items.description: Animate numbers to count up or down to a target number

items.name: shimmer-button
items.title: Shimmer Button
items.description: A button with a shimmering light which travels around the perimeter.

items.name: shine-border
items.title: Shine Border
items.description: Shine border is an animated background border effect.

items.name: glass-card
items.title: Glass Card
items.description: Frosted glass surface with optional edge-lens refraction (Chromium + mouse). Solid fallback for reduced transparency.

items.name: glass-button
items.title: Glass Button
items.description: Pill glass button with spring press feedback; default, tinted (brand) and accent variants.

items.name: glass-navbar
items.title: Glass Navbar
items.description: Sticky frosted navigation bar, full-width or floating pill, safe-area aware.

items.name: segmented-control
items.title: Segmented Control
items.description: Segmented control with a spring-animated thumb and radiogroup keyboard support.

items.name: scroll-reveal-text
items.title: Scroll Reveal Text
items.description: Paragraph that lights up word by word as you scroll (Thai-aware word segmentation).

items.name: sticky-showcase
items.title: Sticky Showcase
items.description: Sticky visual beside scrolling feature copy; stacks on mobile.

items.name: zoom-parallax
items.title: Zoom Parallax
items.description: Full-bleed media that shrinks into a rounded card on scroll while the headline fades out.

items.name: dock
items.title: Dock
items.description: Magnifying icon dock on glass; press feedback instead of magnification on touch.

items.name: animated-tabs
items.title: Animated Tabs
items.description: Radix tabs with a spring-animated indicator (pill or underline).

items.name: drawer
items.title: Drawer
items.description: Mobile bottom sheet with drag-to-dismiss handle, safe-area padding; Radix Dialog accessibility. Optional snapPoints make it rest at several heights.

items.name: tab-bar
items.title: Tab Bar
items.description: Glass bottom tab bar for mobile web/PWA with spring active pill and safe-area padding.

items.name: section-header
items.title: Header
items.description: Site header: brand, links and call to action; frosted once the page scrolls, a menu panel on phones.

items.name: section-hero-split
items.title: Hero split
items.description: Two-column hero: headline, copy, two calls to action, trust points and a product mockup.

items.name: section-hero-centered
items.title: Hero centered
items.description: Centered hero with a soft brand glow, two calls to action and a row of customer avatars.

items.name: section-logo-cloud
items.title: Logo cloud
items.description: “Trusted by” row of customer logos, muted until hovered.

items.name: section-testimonials
items.title: Testimonials
items.description: Customer quotes in cards with rating, name and role.

items.name: section-stats
items.title: Stats
items.description: Big numbers that count up when they scroll into view.

items.name: section-feature-grid
items.title: Feature grid
items.description: Feature grid with icon tiles, titles and one-line descriptions.

items.name: section-feature-scroll
items.title: Feature scroll
items.description: Story told while scrolling: copy on one side, a sticky visual that changes with it.

items.name: section-feature-slideshow
items.title: Feature slideshow
items.description: Feature tabs that advance with a progress bar; pause button, no autoplay under reduced motion.

items.name: section-feature-bento
items.title: Feature bento
items.description: Bento grid of feature cards in mixed sizes with small visuals.

items.name: section-carousel
items.title: Carousel
items.description: Horizontal carousel with snap, previous/next buttons and dots; no autoplay.

items.name: section-pricing
items.title: Pricing
items.description: Three plans with a monthly/yearly switch and a highlighted popular plan.

items.name: section-faq
items.title: FAQ
items.description: Questions and answers in an accordion next to a heading and contact link.

items.name: section-cta
items.title: Call to action
items.description: Closing call to action on a brand-gradient band.

items.name: section-contact
items.title: Contact
items.description: Company details beside a short form with a Thai phone field.

items.name: section-footer
items.title: Footer
items.description: Site footer with brand, link columns and a bottom bar.

items.name: login-page
items.title: Login page
items.description: Split-screen sign-in: brand gradient panel with a glass testimonial, and an email/password form.

items.name: dashboard-page
items.title: Dashboard
items.description: Customer-service dashboard: sidebar, date-range filter, stat cards, and a cases table with channel filter and row actions.

items.name: mobile-app-page
items.title: Mobile app shell
items.description: Mobile web / PWA shell: glass top bar, segmented filter, chat list, bottom tab bar and a compose drawer.

items.name: landing-page
items.title: Landing page
items.description: Marketing page: glass navbar, animated hero, logo marquee, feature cards with spotlight, stats and a call to action.

items.name: console-page
items.title: Contact center console
items.description: Agent console: collapsible sidebar, searchable chat list with filters and unread counts, the conversation, and a case panel with SLA countdown, tags and activity. List and chat switch views on phones.

items.name: register-page
items.title: Thai sign-up
items.description: Four-step sign-up: account, Thai citizen ID (check digit), phone with SMS code, and Thai address with postal-code lookup, then a summary.
